vegetarian_notes.qdoba: Listed items are the Fajita Vegan Bowl and the rice and beans QDOBA marks (v) as vegan in its official nutrition facts. Build a bowl or burrito from them in the QDOBA calculator.
vegetarian_notes.mcdonalds: In the U.S., McDonald's fries and hash browns contain natural beef flavor, so they are not vegetarian. McDonald's does not label any item vegetarian. Breakfast items without meat in the recipe, such as Hotcakes, Fruit & Maple Oatmeal and the Egg and Cheese Biscuit, are in the calculator; check McDonald's ingredient list before relying on them.
vegetarian_notes.kfc: KFC's gravy, green beans and BBQ baked beans are left out because they may contain meat or meat flavoring.
vegetarian_notes.chipotle: Build a bowl or burrito from sofritas, rice, beans, salsas, cheese and guacamole; every part is in the Chipotle calculator.
vegetarian_notes.burger-king: The Impossible Whopper is not in our Burger King data yet, so only sides and desserts are listed.
vegetarian_notes.taco-bell: Listed items are the ones Taco Bell marks (V) as vegetarian in its official U.S. nutrition table.
vegetarian_notes.panda-express: Panda Express cooks in shared woks, so vegetarian sides may touch meat dishes.
